A point of view

Since 2016 · Orchard Street Come as you are. Stay as long as you like.

The best nights are unplanned.

Ember & Salt started with a simple idea: food tastes better when it has a sense of place. We cook over live fire, build our menu around what the market gives us, and leave enough space for the evening to take its own shape.
